task: Bug report (Billing): Invoices with a 15% discount and 3+ line items sometimes show a total that differs from the sum of lines by $0.02, and the adjustment line only covers $0.01. Example: order ORD-2231, USD, 15% discount, 8.25% tax, items: MUG-01 1 x $9.99, HOOD-3 1 x $29.99, BOOT-4 2 x $49.99. The invoice total is $128.79 but the lines (including the adjustment) add up to $128.78. Accounting rejects invoices whose lines don't add up to the total. Please fix. Tests are run with `node --experimental-strip-types --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"`.
protected_why: JPY has no minor unit: JPY amounts must stay whole yen (no x100 'cents' scaling, formatted without decimals) and are rounded half-up, not banker's rounding, per the Japanese entity's accounting policy (FIN-88).
